title: Motivic Segre classes of Schubert cells and the connective formal group law
summary: We use the connective formal group law to define a one-parameter ($β$-)deformation of the motivic Segre classes of Schubert cells in the $d$-step flag variety. This $β$-deformation specializes to the motivic Segre classes of Schubert cells when $β=1$ and to the Segre-Schwartz-MacPherson classes of Schubert cells when $β=0$ (though the $β$-deformations are not simply the $β$-homogenizations of the motivic Segre classes).
